senses.definition: adj. steep, hilly (v. √; cf. عَقَبَةٌ difficult mountain path, Qor 90:11; ዐቀብ hill);—Is 40:4 והיה הֶעָקֹב לְמִישׁוֹר let the steep ground (Ch) become a plain (‖ הָֽרְכָסִים). Cf. Ecclus 6:20.
